item.title: How to Revoke a JWT Before It Expires
item.description: ASP.NET Core validates a JWT by its signature and expiry, so a stolen token keeps working after the user changes their password. Worth a read for developers following .NET. Link to article: https://milanjovanovic.tech/blog/revoke-jwt-before-it-expires-token-version

item.title: Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning on Amazon SageMaker AI: A hands-on guide
item.description: Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning (MTRL) on Amazon SageMaker AI trains models on the outcome of a whole multi-step task rather than labeled steps. This hands-on guide walks the full pipeline using Wordle: deploying the agent and reward on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, preparing the dataset, training, and evaluating at serving settings. Worth a read for developers following AWS and AI. Link to article: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/machine-learning/multi-turn-reinforcement-learning-on-amazon-sagemaker-ai-a-hands-on-guide

item.title: MongoClient in ASP.NET Core: Lifetime and Resource Ownership
item.description: Learn MongoClient in ASP.NET Core with explicit configuration, singleton reuse, borrowed collection handles, and version-aware cluster ownership at shutdown. Worth a read for developers following .NET. Link to article: https://www.devleader.ca/2026/10/23/mongoclient-in-aspnet-core-lifetime-and-resource-ownership

item.title: Rapidly scaling online storage to serve over 1 billion ChatGPT users (Part II)

item.title: Orchestrating SageMaker AI endpoint auto scaling with AWS CDK
item.description: Updating a SageMaker AI endpoint that has Application Auto Scaling registered makes AWS CloudFormation and AWS CDK deployments fail. This post shows how to build a reusable AWS CDK construct with CloudFormation custom resources that deregisters and re-registers auto scaling automatically, so you can update the endpoint and its scaling in a single deployment. Worth a read for developers following AWS and AI. Link to article: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/machine-learning/orchestrating-sagemaker-ai-endpoint-auto-scaling-with-aws-cdk

item.title: Visualize points and routes with GeoJSON in Amazon Quick Sight layer maps
item.description: Amazon Quick Sight layer maps now support Point and LineString geometry from the same GeoJSON workflow, so you can plot store locations and the routes between them. This post covers the dataset and GeoJSON structure layer maps require, when to choose points or lines, and techniques for viewport control, layering geometries, and dynamic GeoJSON updates. Worth a read for developers following AWS and AI. Link to article: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/machine-learning/visualize-points-and-routes-with-geojson-in-amazon-quick-sight-layer-maps

item.title: How Bayer Crop Science built an agentic decision engine on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with AWS Unified Operations
item.description: Bayer Crop Science built the Agentic Decision Engine (ADE), a multi-agent platform on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that lets breeders, analysts, and researchers ask natural language questions about their analytics platform. This post covers the ADE architecture, five design decisions, and how the team prepared it for production with AWS Unified Operations. Worth a read for developers following AWS and AI. Link to article: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/machine-learning/how-bayer-crop-science-built-an-agentic-decision-engine-on-amazon-bedrock-agentcore-with-aws-unified-operations

item.title: Announcing new ways to customize models with SageMaker AI, without managing GPUs
item.description: Amazon SageMaker AI serverless model customization now includes training sessions, generally available today. You write and coordinate your own post-training loop (custom loss functions, reward signals, or multi-turn reinforcement learning) while SageMaker AI handles GPU allocation, distributed execution, fault recovery, and checkpoint storage. Worth a read for developers following AI and AWS. Link to article: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/machine-learning/announcing-new-ways-to-customize-models-with-sagemaker-ai-without-managing-gpus

item.title: Write your own training loop — without managing GPUs — with Amazon SageMaker training session APIs
item.description: Amazon SageMaker AI training session APIs let you write your own LLM training loop (SFT, RL, or custom objectives) in a Python script while the service runs the GPUs. This post introduces the programming model and three SDK clients, then walks through a GRPO loop on GSM8K and a reinforcement learning workload on competitive programming. Worth a read for developers following AWS and AI. Link to article: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/machine-learning/write-your-own-training-loop-without-managing-gpus-with-amazon-sagemaker-training-sessions

item.title: Deploy AI in a HIPAA-eligible environment with Amazon Quick
item.description: Amazon Quick is a HIPAA-eligible service, but eligibility is not the same as compliance. This post explains who HIPAA applies to, how PHI flows through Amazon Quick, what the platform provides for regulated environments, and a step-by-step guide to deploying compliant AI agents in a healthcare environment. Worth a read for developers following AWS and AI. Link to article: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/machine-learning/deploy-ai-in-a-hipaa-eligible-environment-with-amazon-quick

item.title: Stream low-latency speech from AI agents using Kokoro TTS on Amazon SageMaker AI
item.description: Voice agents often wait for an agent's full response before starting speech synthesis, adding latency users feel directly. This post shows how to stream each sentence to a Kokoro-82M text-to-speech model on Amazon SageMaker AI as the agent produces it, and how to get that audio back to a browser over Server-Sent Events or a unified binary transport. Worth a read for developers following AWS and AI. Link to article: https://aws.

item.title: Stop guessing auto scaling targets for TTS on Amazon SageMaker AI
item.description: Teams deploying custom text-to-speech models on Amazon SageMaker AI often guess at autoscaling thresholds, and a wrong guess either wastes GPU spend or breaches a latency SLO. This post deploys Kokoro-82M as a custom container and derives a measured autoscaling policy from two live-endpoint measurements, Q_max and T_total, instead of guesswork. Worth a read for developers following AWS and AI. Link to article: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/machine-learning/stop-guessing-auto-scaling-targets-for-tts-on-amazon-sagemaker-ai

item.title: Beyond the KV cache: Training and serving i14’s Laplace 3B linear attention model on AWS Trainium2 with native PyTorch
item.description: Learn how i14 trained and served Laplace 3B, a linear attention model, on AWS Trainium2 using native PyTorch. Its recurrent state stays fixed at 29.5 MB per sequence regardless of context length, avoiding the growing key-value cache of transformer models and keeping serving memory predictable. Worth a read for developers following AWS and AI. Link to article: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/machine-learning/beyond-the-kv-cache-training-and-serving-i14s-laplace-3b-linear-attention-model-on-aws-trainium2-with-native-pytorch

SFT took reasoning-language accuracy from 22% to 100%, and GRPO added measurable gains where headroom existed. Worth a read for developers following AWS and AI. Worth a read for developers following AWS and AI. Link to article: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/machine-learning/securing-ai-agent-identity-with-x-509-pki-on-aws
